description: October 26 birthday meaning: Scorpio decan 1, birthday number 8, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an October 26 birthday falls in Scorpio, in the first decan, with Pluto as the sign's ruler and Pluto as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 8. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Scorpio is fixed and water.

sections.heading: October 26 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Power is a word that comes up often around October 26. The Sun at roughly two degrees of Scorpio sits in the Pluto decan, linked with transformation and strategic intensity, and the birthday number 8 concerns authority, resources and results. Interpretively, this is a quietly formidable profile: someone who reads situations accurately and acts decisively when the moment arrives.

On October 26 the Sun usually sits at about 2° Scorpio, in the first decan, where Pluto rules the decan as well as the sign. Pluto rules Scorpio in modern astrology and also governs its first decan, so late October and the first days of November hold the sign in concentrated form. This decan is traditionally associated with intensity, privacy and a capacity to go deep into whatever it touches, whether a relationship, a mystery or a personal reinvention. Trust tends to be slow and, once given, complete. Doubled Pluto can bring a strong will and a reluctance to show vulnerability. Natives often find their power in honest transformation: releasing what no longer fits rather than guarding it out of habit.

sections.heading: October 26 in numerology
paragraphs: A birthday on the 26th reduces as 2 + 6 = 8. Here the 2's cooperative instinct and the 6's sense of responsibility build towards the 8's practical power. Twenty-sixth-born people are often described as capable organisers who lead through care, managing a household, a business or a community with both warmth and firmness. They tend to think about security for the people they love. As a secondary number, the 26 is traditionally associated with sound judgement in material matters. Balancing control with trust in others is often part of their path.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one October 26 birthday to the next: it is 7 for 1960, 8 for 1970, 9 for 1980 and 1 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11.

sections.heading: Born on October 26: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: October birthdays fall in mid-autumn north of the equator, with turning leaves and earlier evenings, and in mid-spring in the southern hemisphere. Libra holds most of the month, with Scorpio arriving around October 23. In numerology October is month 10, which reduces to 1: a number of new starts and independence, carried here with a 0 that is often read as amplifying it. October 26 is the 299th day of the year (300th in a leap year). By November 23, 28 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Sagittarius.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by October 26, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on October 26 include François Mitterrand (1916), Evo Morales (1959) and Mohammad Reza I of Iran (1919).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is October 26?
faq.answer: October 26 is Scorpio in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Scorpio, which tradition links with Pluto.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on October 26?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On October 26 the Life Path is 7 in 1960, 8 in 1970, 9 in 1980, 1 in 1990, 11 in 2000, 3 in 2010 and 4 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 8 for everyone born on the 26th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on October 26?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for an October 26 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on October 26?
faq.answer: October 26 is also the birthday of François Mitterrand (1916), Evo Morales (1959) and Mohammad Reza I of Iran (1919). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
